study.title: OEDRO AI Research for Drivers
study.goal: Learn from five real vehicle owners whether a switchable wide-versus-distance light bar solves a real task, what each mode must show, and what would prevent installation or use.
decisionQuestions: Which real night-driving or work situations are poorly served by the lights owners already use?
When, if ever, would owners use one proposed light bar with switchable near-wide and forward-distance beams?
What comparable evidence, tradeoffs, fitment and cost questions determine whether the concept deserves development?

audience.description: Adult vehicle owners who use their vehicle after dark, especially recent light buyers or active owners with relevant real use. Five complete, comprehensible interviews are the research target.
eligibility: Has driven, worked, camped or otherwise used a vehicle after dark, or can explicitly say they have not
Voluntarily agrees to this research interview

claims.text: Hypothetical lens-based added light bar with a user-switchable wide nearby beam and a farther-reaching forward beam. No brightness, fitment, release date or performance is established.
claims.source: User-directed qualitative concept test; internal work-light MRD and prior owner feedback. Concept description only, not a tested product claim.

en.title: Before we begin
en.intro: OEDRO is asking about your real experience with vehicle lights and a possible new light-bar idea. This is a text interview of about 10 minutes. The idea is not a finished or tested product.
items: Your answers are saved for this research, processed by an AI service, and retained for up to 30 days. You can stop or delete your answers here.
Please do not enter your name, email, phone number, address, or other contact details. There is no automatic reward on this page.
en.checkbox: I understand and agree to take part.

zh-CN.title: 开始之前
zh-CN.intro: OEDRO 想了解你实际用车灯的经历，以及一款仍在设想中的长条灯。文字访谈大约需要 10 分钟；这不是已上市或已验证的产品。
items: 回答会用于本次研究，由 AI 服务处理，最多保留 30 天。你可以停止访谈，或在页面上删除回答。
请不要填写姓名、邮箱、电话、住址等联系信息。本页面不会自动发放奖励。

es.title: Antes de empezar
es.intro: OEDRO quiere conocer tu experiencia real con las luces del vehículo y una posible idea para una barra de luces. La entrevista escrita dura unos 10 minutos. No es un producto terminado ni probado.
items: Tus respuestas se guardan para esta investigación, las procesa un servicio de IA y se conservan hasta 30 días. Puedes parar o borrar tus respuestas aquí.
No escribas tu nombre, correo, teléfono, dirección ni otros datos de contacto. Esta página no entrega recompensas automáticamente.
es.checkbox: Entiendo la información y acepto participar.

dataPolicy.providerDisclosure: Answers are processed by a configured third-party AI provider for interview understanding, controlled follow-up, and evidence extraction.

fields.description: Vehicle manufacturer as stated or cautiously normalized
Vehicle model as stated or kept as a candidate
The purpose of ordinary after-dark vehicle use, as stated. Keep trip purpose separate from road type, available light, and weather; do not infer one from another.

Non-identifying context of the most recent after-dark use. Preserve stated road type, available light, or weather as separate facts; do not infer any from another. For a driver who only says on the road, clarify road type only if needed. For stationary use, ask about the activity or work surface instead. Never collect an address or demand all context dimensions.
What the participant could or could not see during that recent use, including an explicit report that they could see clearly. Do not assume a problem or turn uncertainty into a problem.
What the participant did in response
What matters to the participant when choosing vehicle lights, in their own words; no ranked list or minimum number is required.
A stated practical obstacle to adding or using an extra vehicle light, including an explicit report of no obstacle. Do not suggest an installation, cost, or legal problem.
Spontaneous reaction to a hypothetical single added light bar with switchable wide nearby and farther-forward beam settings; preserve rejection and uncertainty.

Exploratory self-stated total cost, including installation, that the owner might consider for this unpriced concept, or explicit no interest/uncertainty. Do not treat as willingness-to-pay evidence for a specified product or infer a price.
The participant's stated reason for considering a listed size and price, considering none, or being unsure. Do not assume cost or lack of need is the reason.
The participant's desired first change to the hypothetical extra vehicle light, or an explicit statement that no change is needed or there is not enough information to judge.
The specific real situation, if any, in which the owner would use either proposed beam setting. Keep wide and forward uses distinct.
Evidence or comparable night-test conditions the owner would need to judge both proposed settings, including concern that one or both settings might compromise performance.

anchors.label: Use context
anchors.objective: Establish one real recent trip or task before describing any new product. Accept no recent after-dark use.
anchors.question: The last time you used your vehicle after dark, what were you doing?

questionLocales.en: The last time you used your vehicle after dark, what were you doing?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 最近一次天黑后用车时，你在做什么？
questionLocales.es: La última vez que usaste tu vehículo de noche, ¿qué estabas haciendo?

anchors.clarification: The last time you used your vehicle after dark, what were you doing?

clarificationLocales.en: The last time you used your vehicle after dark, what were you doing?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 最近一次天黑后用车时，你在做什么？
clarificationLocales.es: La última vez que usaste tu vehículo de noche, ¿qué estabas haciendo?

sufficiencyCriteria: A concrete answer, an explicit no need or no experience, or honest uncertainty is understood in the owner’s own words. Do not invent a problem or force agreement.
highValueProbeTargets: Clarify the one activity or trip purpose only when the answer is not understandable.

anchors.label: Recent experience
anchors.objective: Record one concrete visibility outcome during the same event, including no difficulty. Clarify road or task setting only when it changes the meaning.
anchors.question: During that same trip or task, was anything hard to see? If so, what?

questionLocales.en: During that same trip or task, was anything hard to see? If so, what?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 那次用车时，有什么东西看不清吗？如果有，是什么？
questionLocales.es: Durante ese mismo viaje o tarea, ¿hubo algo que te costara ver? Si lo hubo, ¿qué fue?

anchors.clarification: During that same trip or task, was anything hard to see? If so, what?

clarificationLocales.en: During that same trip or task, was anything hard to see? If so, what?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 那次用车时，有什么东西看不清吗？如果有，是什么？
clarificationLocales.es: Durante ese mismo viaje o tarea, ¿hubo algo que te costara ver? Si lo hubo, ¿qué fue?

sufficiencyCriteria: A concrete answer, an explicit no need or no experience, or honest uncertainty is understood in the owner’s own words. Do not invent a problem or force agreement.
highValueProbeTargets: Clarify one object, area or task that was hard to see, without assuming a problem.

anchors.label: Priorities
anchors.objective: Identify one owner-selected criterion before the concept; factory lights count and no extra-light experience is valid.
anchors.question: From the vehicle lights you have used, what one thing matters most to you in real use?

questionLocales.en: From the vehicle lights you have used, what one thing matters most to you in real use?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 在你用过的车灯里，实际使用时你最在意哪一点？
questionLocales.es: De las luces de vehículo que has usado, ¿qué es lo que más te importa en la práctica?

anchors.clarification: From the vehicle lights you have used, what one thing matters most to you in real use?

clarificationLocales.en: From the vehicle lights you have used, what one thing matters most to you in real use?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 在你用过的车灯里，实际使用时你最在意哪一点？
clarificationLocales.es: De las luces de vehículo que has usado, ¿qué es lo que más te importa en la práctica?

sufficiencyCriteria: A concrete answer, an explicit no need or no experience, or honest uncertainty is understood in the owner’s own words. Do not invent a problem or force agreement.
highValueProbeTargets: Clarify a vague criterion with the owner’s own example, only if needed.

anchors.label: Concept
anchors.objective: Present an untested switchable wide-versus-distance concept without promising performance. Learn whether either mode fits a specific actual task, or not.
anchors.question: Imagine one added light bar with two settings you can switch between: a wide beam for nearby ground and side areas, and a narrower beam that reaches farther ahead. In what real situation, if any, would you use it?

questionLocales.en: Imagine one added light bar with two settings you can switch between: a wide beam for nearby ground and side areas, and a narrower beam that reaches farther ahead. In what real situation, if any, would you use it?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 设想在车上加装一根长条灯，可以切换两种光型：一种照亮近处和两侧较宽的区域，另一种照向更远的前方。你会在什么实际场景使用它？如果不会，也可以直说。
questionLocales.es: Imagina una barra de luces adicional con dos modos: uno amplio para el suelo cercano y los lados, y otro más estrecho que ilumina más lejos hacia delante. ¿En qué situación real la usarías, si es que la usarías?

anchors.clarification: Imagine one added light bar with two settings you can switch between: a wide beam for nearby ground and side areas, and a narrower beam that reaches farther ahead. In what real situation, if any, would you use it?

clarificationLocales.en: Imagine one added light bar with two settings you can switch between: a wide beam for nearby ground and side areas, and a narrower beam that reaches farther ahead. In what real situation, if any, would you use it?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 设想在车上加装一根长条灯，可以切换两种光型：一种照亮近处和两侧较宽的区域，另一种照向更远的前方。你会在什么实际场景使用它？如果不会，也可以直说。
clarificationLocales.es: Imagina una barra de luces adicional con dos modos: uno amplio para el suelo cercano y los lados, y otro más estrecho que ilumina más lejos hacia delante. ¿En qué situación real la usarías, si es que la usarías?

sufficiencyCriteria: A concrete answer, an explicit no need or no experience, or honest uncertainty is understood in the owner’s own words. Do not invent a problem or force agreement.
highValueProbeTargets: Ask which setting maps to a real situation, only if an interested response leaves that unclear.

anchors.label: Night-test evidence
anchors.objective: Explain lens in terms of the beam outcome. Do not claim lenses are brighter or better. Capture comparable proof needed and any concern about one mode weakening the other.
anchors.question: The idea would use lenses to shape those two beams. What would you need to see in a real night test to judge whether both settings work for you?

questionLocales.en: The idea would use lenses to shape those two beams. What would you need to see in a real night test to judge whether both settings work for you?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 这个设想会用透镜形成刚才说的两种光型。要判断两种光型是否适合你，你想在真实夜间测试里看到什么？
questionLocales.es: La idea usaría lentes para formar esos dos haces. ¿Qué tendrías que ver en una prueba nocturna real para juzgar si ambos modos te sirven?

anchors.clarification: The idea would use lenses to shape those two beams. What would you need to see in a real night test to judge whether both settings work for you?

clarificationLocales.en: The idea would use lenses to shape those two beams. What would you need to see in a real night test to judge whether both settings work for you?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 这个设想会用透镜形成刚才说的两种光型。要判断两种光型是否适合你，你想在真实夜间测试里看到什么？
clarificationLocales.es: La idea usaría lentes para formar esos dos haces. ¿Qué tendrías que ver en una prueba nocturna real para juzgar si ambos modos te sirven?

sufficiencyCriteria: A concrete answer, an explicit no need or no experience, or honest uncertainty is understood in the owner’s own words. Do not invent a problem or force agreement.
highValueProbeTargets: Clarify one test condition or comparison the owner would trust.

anchors.label: Constraints
anchors.objective: Find concrete fitment, wiring, control, heat, wind, legal-use or other barriers only when the owner volunteers them; no obstacle is valid.
anchors.question: For your vehicle, what could make installing or using that two-setting light difficult, if anything?

questionLocales.en: For your vehicle, what could make installing or using that two-setting light difficult, if anything?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 对你的车来说，安装或使用这款可切换两种光型的灯，有什么可能的困难？如果没有，也可以说没有。
questionLocales.es: En tu vehículo, ¿qué podría dificultar instalar o usar esa luz de dos modos, si hubiera algo?

anchors.clarification: For your vehicle, what could make installing or using that two-setting light difficult, if anything?

clarificationLocales.en: For your vehicle, what could make installing or using that two-setting light difficult, if anything?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 对你的车来说，安装或使用这款可切换两种光型的灯，有什么可能的困难？如果没有，也可以说没有。
clarificationLocales.es: En tu vehículo, ¿qué podría dificultar instalar o usar esa luz de dos modos, si hubiera algo?

sufficiencyCriteria: A concrete answer, an explicit no need or no experience, or honest uncertainty is understood in the owner’s own words. Do not invent a problem or force agreement.
highValueProbeTargets: Clarify one owner-mentioned obstacle that could affect use.

placeholder.zh-CN: 按自己的实际情况回答…

anchors.label: Price
anchors.objective: Exploratory cost threshold only. No invented size, price tier or purchase intent; explicit no interest and uncertainty are valid.
anchors.question: No size or price has been set for this idea. Including installation, roughly what total cost would you consider, if you would consider it at all?

questionLocales.en: No size or price has been set for this idea. Including installation, roughly what total cost would you consider, if you would consider it at all?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 这个设想还没有确定尺寸和价格。算上安装，如果你会考虑它，大约什么总价在你的考虑范围内？不考虑也可以直说。
questionLocales.es: Esta idea aún no tiene tamaño ni precio definidos. Incluida la instalación, ¿qué coste total aproximado considerarías, si la considerarías?

anchors.clarification: No size or price has been set for this idea. Including installation, roughly what total cost would you consider, if you would consider it at all?

clarificationLocales.en: No size or price has been set for this idea. Including installation, roughly what total cost would you consider, if you would consider it at all?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 这个设想还没有确定尺寸和价格。算上安装，如果你会考虑它，大约什么总价在你的考虑范围内？不考虑也可以直说。
clarificationLocales.es: Esta idea aún no tiene tamaño ni precio definidos. Incluida la instalación, ¿qué coste total aproximado considerarías, si la considerarías?

sufficiencyCriteria: A concrete answer, an explicit no need or no experience, or honest uncertainty is understood in the owner’s own words. Do not invent a problem or force agreement.
highValueProbeTargets: If a number is given, clarify whether it includes installation only when necessary.

anchors.label: Final change
anchors.objective: Record one owner-generated change after evaluating use, proof, fit and exploratory cost; no change is valid.

highValueProbeTargets: Clarify one proposed change only when its object is unclear.
